messages:
Nina (Marketing): Heads-up: post-webinar checklist — need final recording link, edited 2-min highlight, captions, and clear lead routing. Who's owning each?
Leo (Growth): I can own lead routing + GA/UTM check. Do we want 'attended' set on all viewers or only registrants who joined?
Priya (Events): We'll mark attended=true for Zoom joiners. Zoom provides watch_pct in the attendee report. I'll export CSV and push to the automation.
Tom (Sales): Sales wants engaged leads only. Define engaged = watch_pct >= 40% OR asked a question in chat. Tag in CRM as webinar:low-latency and webinar:engaged where applicable.
Nina (Marketing): Good. Email workflows: 1) Attendees -> thank-you + recording + benchmark PDF + engaged -> include Calendly link. 2) Registrants who didn't attend -> recording + invite to office hours. Draft copy below for review.
Nina (Marketing): "Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for joining our Low-Latency Inference webinar. Watch the recording: https://drive.redwood.ai/webinars/2026-03-lowlatency/full.mp4. Get the benchmark PDF: https://redwood.ai/resources/ll-benchmark. Interested in a quick demo? If you watched >40% we'll send a Calendly link."
Leo (Growth): Minor edits: add UTM params to both links (utm_campaign=webinar_ll2026&utm_source=email) and shorten the drive link via our redirect. Also add a 2-question feedback survey link.
Priya (Events): ZoomBot: cloud recording ready (host: nina@redwood.ai) - https://zoom.us/rec/share/XyZ_example (passcode: rdw2026). Recording retention set to 30 days; we should download and archive to GDrive.
ZoomBot: Recording created by host nina@redwood.ai at 2026-03-xx 16:45 UTC.
Nina (Marketing): I'll download and ask Creative for a 90-120s social clip with captions. Priya, can you export attendee report and share the CSV to #ops-automation?
Priya (Events): Will do. Export fields: email, name, join_time, leave_time, watch_pct, q&a_flag, chat_messages. Uploading to drive: drive.redwood.ai/marketing/exports/2026-03-lowlatency-attendance.csv
Leo (Growth): Routing plan: use Make (Integromat) scenario: Trigger=Google Drive CSV upload -> Parse rows -> Lookup Lead in SFDC -> Update/Create Lead fields: webinar_source=Webinar-LL-2026, attended={{true/false}}, watch_pct={{watch_pct}}, tag: webinar:low-latency; If watch_pct>=40 OR q&a_flag=true -> add to SFDC queue 'Inbound Webinar - Engaged' and send to Calendly campaign webhook.
Tom (Sales): For engaged leads, create task: "Follow up on webinar: ask about latency goals + propose quick demo". Assign to 'SDR-Inbound' if company size < 200, otherwise assign to AE queue.
Nina (Marketing): Team actions summary: Priya downloads recording + uploads captions.srt; Creative makes 90s clip; Leo builds Make scenario and UTM rules; Tom confirms SFDC task templates. Aim to have everything live by EOD Friday.
Leo (Growth): Quick note: set Zap/Make to only trigger Calendly for leads with watch_pct >=40 to avoid spam. Also append utm_content=clip in social links.
Priya (Events): I'll DM credentials for the Zoom host account to Leo for API config.
Nina (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll post final email templates and the link to the archived recording here when done. :sparkles:
